scope: Independently authored labeled scenarios. HTML and snippets are synthetic unit/evaluation inputs, not captured SerpApi responses or actual fetched pages. Expected labels encode explicit reviewed semantics, not production accuracy.
limitations: Curated fixtures are not a random sample of real-world results.
This suite does not measure live API success, latency, general search relevance, or production accuracy.
Published source URLs identify documentation families; evaluation HTML is explicitly authored input, not a capture from those URLs.

cases.rationale: Native V1 BaseModel exposes parse_obj.
explanations: Native BaseModel.parse_obj is supported in V1; V2 retains it with a deprecation warning.

cases.rationale: V2 native BaseModel retains parse_obj with documented deprecation.
explanations: Native BaseModel.parse_obj is supported in V1; V2 retains it with a deprecation warning.

cases.rationale: Native V1 BaseModel has no model_validate.
explanations: Native BaseModel.model_validate is the V2 replacement; native V1 models lack this API.

cases.rationale: Native V2 BaseModel exposes model_validate.
explanations: Native BaseModel.model_validate is the V2 replacement; native V1 models lack this API.

cases.rationale: A range crossing the migration boundary cannot establish an exact API version.
explanations: Dependency version is a range, missing, or conflicting; applicability is unresolved.

cases.rationale: No Pydantic declaration establishes a target version.
explanations: Dependency version is a range, missing, or conflicting; applicability is unresolved.

cases.rationale: A search snippet cannot replace unavailable fetched source.
explanations: Source page could not be verified; a search snippet is insufficient.

cases.rationale: Unstructured snippet text is not a verified source recipe.
explanations: Unstructured source text cannot establish a scoped code recipe.

cases.rationale: Unknown native versus V1 shim context changes API behavior.

cases.rationale: A native source recipe does not establish applicability to a V1-shim target.

cases.rationale: An API-like token without import and BaseModel provenance is insufficient.

cases.rationale: An unreviewed release line must not inherit a rule.
explanations: This Pydantic version is outside the reviewed rule range (1.10.x or 2.0–2.14.x).

cases.rationale: Prereleases are outside the reviewed stable release rules.
explanations: Prerelease, development, local, and postrelease versions are outside the reviewed rules.

cases.rationale: 1.4 future-mode Engine.execute is disabled.

cases.rationale: Unknown 1.4 future mode changes Engine.execute behavior.
